# Ars Magna

Ars Magna is a Notation-inspired theme that folds Andy Matuschak mode and other community contributions into one visual style. Its two modes are named lucis for light and umbra for dark, and the recorded description states that the appearance stays consistent between them.

![Ars Magna screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mediapathic/obsidian-arsmagna-theme/HEAD/arsmagna.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ars Magna"
    author: "mediapathic"
    repo:   "mediapathic/obsidian-arsmagna-theme"
    slug:   "ars-magna"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ars-magna"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/mediapathic/obsidian-arsmagna-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mediapathic/obsidian-arsmagna-theme/HEAD/arsmagna.png"

    modes:  ["dark", "light"]
    legacy: true
    about:  "Apply a Notation-inspired Obsidian theme that blends Andy Matuschak mode and other community contributions into a cohesive visual style. Maintain a consistent appearance in both lucis (light) and umbra (dark) modes."
}
```
